fields.label: Mode
fields.help: auto: buy the longer cache tier once this conversation has shown it pauses long enough to lose the short one. short: always leave the harness default. long: always buy the longer tier. off: never touch breakpoints.

fields.label: Min Gap For Long Tier (seconds)
fields.help: How long an observed pause must be before the longer tier is bought. 0 uses 30% of that tier's lifetime, so one unusual pause does not commit a short conversation.
